svg.text: PYDANTIC V2 — ALL DECORATORS CHEAT SHEET
2026 • VALIDATORS • SERIALIZERS • COMPUTED FIELDS • FUNCTION CALLS • DATACLASSES
Validate one or more fields. Choose when your logic should run.
BEFORE → raw value before core type validation
AFTER → typed value after core validation (default)
PLAIN → replaces core validation; return final value
WRAP → receives handler; call it or short-circuit
Use for cross-field rules or raw input that affects the complete model.
BEFORE → raw input; AFTER → validated instance
WRAP → handler-based control around model validation
After validator must return the validated instance.
Customize how a field appears in model_dump() / model_dump_json().
p.model_dump_json() # tags become a sorted JSON list
WRAP → call handler(value), then customize the result
Can target multiple fields; use return_type when needed.
Serializer info provides mode, context and field details.
Customize the complete output object, not just one field.
PLAIN → return a completely custom output object
WRAP → handler(self), then modify the serialized result
Use return_type when the output shape/type is not obvious.
A model serializer can change the whole serialization shape.
Serializes a property / cached_property and adds it to serialization JSON Schema.
Options: alias, title, description, repr, return_type,
The property itself is NOT validated; cache invalidation
Validate annotated arguments before execution; optionally validate the return value.
def discount(price: float, percent: float) -> float:
Use for service functions, utilities and API boundaries.
Creates a standard-style dataclass with Pydantic validation, without BaseModel methods.
point = Point(x="3", y=4) # x is validated
Use TypeAdapter(Point) for validation, JSON Schema or
Do NOT apply @dataclass to a BaseModel subclass.
Callable metadata classes for Annotated types — related tools, but NOT @ decorators.
BeforeValidator → raw input before core validation
AfterValidator → typed value after core validation
WrapValidator → receives handler for control / fallback
Use these to create reusable, composable field types.
Know which hook receives raw input, typed values, instances or serialized output.
raw input → model BEFORE → field BEFORE → core type
→ field AFTER → model AFTER → validated instance
WRAP validators can call the next handler or skip it.
computed_field values are included in serialized output.
STACKING — field validator as class method:
Raise ValueError / AssertionError for invalid data.
10 DEPRECATED — DO NOT USE IN NEW V2 CODE
V1 names remain for migration compatibility but are deprecated.
allow_reuse=True is no longer needed for normal reuse.
put constraints on item types with Annotated instead.
decorators used alongside Pydantic, not Pydantic APIs.
CURRENT Pydantic decorator set covered here:
ANNOTATED HELPERS (not decorators): BeforeValidator • AfterValidator • PlainValidator • WrapValidator
Check installed Pydantic version and official API docs for version-specific options.
Official docs: pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest • No deprecated v1 APIs in the examples
